about: Malformed inputs for the readers reachable from the tools in this folder. SEC-08 names the corpus, the residual risk in wc3-spec-parsers-v1.md names what it does not reach. The map, object, trigger and script parsers are C# over native CascLib and no case here touches them.

cases.why: an empty file is not a document
a half written file is what a reader sees mid write
bytes that are not utf-8, the shape a corrupt manifest takes
a nul byte inside a manifest
nesting deep enough to exhaust the reader's stack
a record that is not an object

cases.expect_text: a version alone is not provenance
cases.why: the record PKG-13 exists to refuse
a record that names a commit and no digest
the requirements file as a bare list
a gaps field that is not a list
a requirement that is a string where an object belongs
a truncated sha256 in a sidecar
an empty sidecar
an uppercase digest is still a digest and is read folded
an empty exe
an MZ header with no version resource behind it
bytes that are not a portable executable at all

cases.payload: this is not a portable executable
cases.why: a text file named as an exe
a table row far wider than any real row
markdown that is not utf-8

cases.payload: This sentence states no counts at all.
cases.why: a counts sentence the guard depends on, missing
a version key holding a number, which is not a version string
a manifest cut off mid key
